alternatives.text: Medicaid non-emergency medical transport for dialysis patients (and similar needs) – call number on plan card or Medicaid MCO

barriers.reason: Patient lacks reliable transport to grocery store; depends on buses and may not afford or obtain renal‑friendly foods

alternatives.text: Ask dialysis/pulmonary rehab dietitian to tailor meals using foods the patient can reach via bus
Greater Chicago Food Depository pantry – open Mon/Wed/Fri 9 am‑1 pm; call 312‑555‑1234 for schedule
Check if Medicaid MCO offers medically tailored meals; if covered, enroll for delivery of renal‑appropriate meals
